name: MX Control
author: Zach Wilke
description: Logi Options+ for the Omarchy bar. Control Logitech MX mice and keyboards over Bluetooth, USB, Bolt, or Unifying.

required.name: python3
required.purpose: Runs mxctl.py (stdlib only unless Solaar is installed)

required.name: bash
required.purpose: Creates the runtime directory and optional udev helper command

optional.name: Solaar
optional.purpose: HID++ via logitech_receiver; udev rules for /dev/hidraw*

optional.name: BlueZ
optional.purpose: Bluetooth battery overlay when HID++ is not open

optional.name: systemd / udev
optional.purpose: Optional user-initiated udevadm reload for hidraw permissions

barWidget.description: Battery and settings for MX devices on Bluetooth, USB, Bolt, and Unifying
